fairUse.provenance: Noble Knight listing https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2147350031/Pickomino identifies this cover with Rio Grande Games 2005 manufacturer part RGG271. Reiner Knizia independently lists Pickomino (Heckmeck am Bratwurmeck English) as Rio Grande 2005 in his game list https://www.knizia.de/wp-content/uploads/reiner/pdfs/List-Games.pdf. The Zoch/Rio Grande publisher-imprinted English rules dated 2005 at https://cdn.1j1ju.com/medias/85/5e/7c-pickomino-rulebook.pdf confirm this same publication pairing. The box front bears the original Zoch logo, consistent with co-publication; the retailer source does not imply permission. White margin trimmed and reduced to 360 pixels.
